page.overview:
Who is Estil I?

Emperor Estil I was the eleventh Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 206–207 AG), succeeding his brother Alman III as ruler of the Corrino Imperium.

Estil I ruled for only a year before he was replaced with Elrood II, Estil's descendants reclaimed the throne in 345 AG, under his great-grandson Alman IV.
